Bug_Title: NP: Method with Optional return type returns explicit null (NP_OPTIONAL_RETURN_NULL)
Bug_Details:
The usage of Optional return type (java.util.Optional or com.google.common.base.Optional)
always means that explicit null returns were not desired by design.
Returning a null value in such case is a contract violation and will most likely break client code.
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates the violation of the Optional return type rule. The rule states that the usage of Optional return type always means that explicit null returns were not desired by design. Here, a method that is supposed to return an Optional of a String, returns null instead, which violates the rule.
Trigger_Explanation: The method showBug() in class OptionalReturnNullBug returns null. The Optional type should not return null. This will lead to a NullPointerException when calling get() on the Optional.
